meta.title: Session auto-resume
meta.description: After DSH starts, resumes sessions whose last turn was cut off in the last seven days and continues them automatically. Only crash-or-shutdown interruptions (interrupted) and cancellations not made by the user (aborted) qualify; sessions stopped by the user, completed, failed, or truncated are left alone. The window, resume cap, continuation message, and dry-run mode are configurable. Resuming spends tokens.
